sections.heading: Signed out automatically while working
sections.text: Sessions end after 30 minutes without activity, and a warning appears 2 minutes before. Typing in a form without saving does not count as activity. The timeout cannot be extended for individual users.

steps.text: Share this article section explaining the 30-minute inactivity timeout and the 2-minute warning.

stop_conditions.text: If the user is signed out within a few minutes of signing in while actively working, stop and escalate to L2 as a possible session fault.
